action: Submit authentication credentials and observe state transition
expected_observation: Observe redirect upon successful login, or error alert upon invalid credentials
actual_observation: On successful auth: URL redirects away from /login (to home or /orders); DOM contains 'خروج' or 'حساب کاربری'. On failure: URL stays on /login, error text rendered in .help-block-error, .alert-danger, .has-error.
notes: Authenticated session cookie '_identity' persists user state.
